notes.title: Snapshot 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
It's been a while coming, but the new version of Snapshot with support for shooting time-lapse sequences is now here!

The time-lapse feature is the most notable change in 1.3, but I've also been working to improve the stability and performance. Plus Snapshot now supports the latest range of Canon EOS cameras.

If you have any feedback or suggestions, please contact me at support@chrishopkin.com

Thank you!

notes.title: Snapshot 1.3 Beta
notes.notes:
I've been working on a new version of Snapshot with support for shooting time-lapse sequences.

I'd like to get some feedback before I release it, so if any current users of Snapshot are interested in beta testing the new version, then please drop me an email at support@chrishopkin.com

The time-lapse feature is the most notable change in 1.3, but I've also made some stability and minor changes, including:
[list]
    [*]Scroll bar no longer appears in the settings area
    [*]Removed annoying highlight in the settings area on Windows 10
    [*]Added support for the following cameras
[list]
    [*]Canon EOS 1D X Mk II
    [*]Canon EOS 5D Mk IV
    [*]Canon EOS 80D
    [*]Canon EOS 1200D / Rebel T5 / Kiss X70
    [*]Canon EOS 1300D / Rebel T6 / Kiss X80
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: New Photo Viewing Options
notes.notes:
Now you can automatically view your captured photos in any installed application, choose your favourite image viewing or editing package, such as Picasa or Photoshop.

Head to the Photo Capture Settings window and choose from the applications listed in the dropdown box.

If your desired application is not listed, you can manually add it, or even add your own custom batch file to process your photos as you capture them.

notes.title: Live View & Photo Viewer
notes.notes:
The latest update to Snapshot is out now!

New features include:

[b]Live View Streaming[/b] - now stream the camera live view to your computer

[b]Photo Saving[/b] - auto save photos to a folder on your computer as you shoot

[b]Photo Viewer[/b] - display photos as you shoot in the built-in viewer


Please get in touch with any comments or suggestions.

notes.title: Snapshot Update Released
notes.notes:
Snapshot now supports complete control of your camera's settings - the value of each setting can now be changed via drop-down boxes.

This update also adds a 'Shoot' button to remotely fire the Shutter Release.

More updates to follow, please get in touch with any feedback or suggestions.
